00Summary at a Glance

Read as of today: wait-and-see bias · re-assess on conditions
The four stocks are grouped as "optical communications," but their earnings substance differs sharply. Only RF Materials shows profit in the numbers; the others are loss-making or just turning profitable. Oct 15 combined a KOSDAQ drop of 7.65%, circuit breakers, and a 5% to 10% fall in US optical stocks the day before. The analysis suggests a staged approach is reasonable: wait for the market shock to settle, then re-assess after the November earnings.
  • Substance varies by stock. RF Materials posted Q2 operating profit of KRW 5.3bn (about USD 3.9mn) at a 21.1% margin. Taihan Fiberoptics swung to a KRW 1.0bn profit in Q2 after losses through the prior quarter. OE Solutions (-KRW 0.9bn) and Lightron (-KRW 2.1bn) are loss-making.
  • Prices are well off their highs. From 52-week highs: Taihan -60.5%, OE Solutions -57.3%, Lightron -53.0%, RF Materials -38.7%. One-year returns are still high at +906% / +82% / +405% / +377% respectively (Taihan / OE Solutions / Lightron / RF Materials).
  • Why today is unfavorable. KOSPI -7.57% and KOSDAQ -7.65% (circuit breakers in both markets; KOSPI down seven sessions in a row), a hotter-than-expected US September core CPI (0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected) and doubts about AI investment returns, and on the previous day Lumentum -9.3%, Ciena -10.2%, Coherent -9.2%, Corning -5.2%.
  • Next checkpoints. The FOMC meeting in late October, Lumentum earnings on Nov 5, and Q3 results for all four companies in mid-November. Consensus Q3 operating profit is KRW 5.9bn for Taihan, KRW 5.1bn for RF Materials, and KRW 1.3bn for OE Solutions.

01Who Makes What

The four companies sit at different stages of the optical communications value chain. In the chain from optical fiber to device packages, to components and modules, to transceivers, each serves different customers at a different pace, so even when they fall on the same day, the reasons are not the same.

Optical fiber and cableTaihan Fiberoptics. Same materials stage as Corning
Cable supply
Hermetic optical device packagesRF Materials. Packages for Lumentum pump lasers
Devices / modules
Optical components and modulesLightron. Makes optical transceivers and modules
Transceivers
Optical transceivers and laser diodes (LD)OE Solutions. In-house laser diodes
Capex
Data centers and carriersEnd demand from AI capex and 5G investment

Is the "AI Optical Theme" Real?

The answer differs by stock. Even within the same chain, some companies make money and others do not yet.

  • RF Materials: real substance: 2025 revenue of KRW 64.1bn (+44%) and operating profit of KRW 7.4bn, a settled return to profit, and a Q2 2026 operating margin of 21.1%. Shinhan Investment Corp. regards it as the near-sole supplier of Lumentum pump-laser packages. Lumentum's fiscal Q4 (through June) revenue was about USD 1.01bn, up 109% YoY.
  • Taihan Fiberoptics: early in the turn to profit: Operating losses of KRW 23.2bn, 29.7bn, and 21.4bn in 2023 to 2025. It turned to a KRW 1.0bn profit in Q2, and Q3 consensus is KRW 5.9bn. Still, the 2026 consensus operating profit of KRW 5.8bn is about 0.3% of market cap.
  • OE Solutions: losses narrowing: The quarterly operating loss narrowed from -KRW 4.0bn in Q2 2025 to -KRW 0.9bn in Q2 2026, and Q3 consensus is a KRW 1.3bn profit. However, Hana Securities classified the company as a wireless communications equipment stock in the title of its May 22 report ("I am a 'wireless equipment stock'").
  • Lightron: weak earnings support: Operating losses of KRW 9.4bn, 10.3bn, and 16.5bn in 2023 to 2025, and Q2 2026 revenue of KRW 4.3bn, about half the prior-year level. There is no consensus. The share price rose more on expectations and flows than on earnings.

Of the four stocks, only RF Materials has seen profit grow markedly from its 2024 low. Taihan Fiberoptics and OE Solutions are estimated at small profits in 2026, and Lightron stays loss-making. Figures for 2026 and later are brokerage estimates; Lightron has none.

2026 estimates are Naver Finance consensus (as of Oct 14 to 15). No 2027 consensus was available in the data checked. RF Materials' 2023 operating profit is shown by Naver as KRW 0 (-0.07%). Unlike the 2026 consensus operating profit, the company guidance cited by Shinhan Investment Corp. (May 7) was lower, at consolidated revenue of KRW 90 to 95bn and operating profit of KRW 12 to 14bn. The two figures are from different dates.

Quarterly Flow: Different Speeds of Turning Profitable

Some are visibly turning profitable, others are not. RF Materials grew each quarter, from KRW 1.9bn to 2.8bn to 3.2bn to 5.3bn, and Q3 consensus is KRW 5.1bn (slightly below Q2). Taihan swung from -KRW 6.7bn to +KRW 1.0bn and is expected to post KRW 5.9bn in Q3. OE Solutions narrowed its loss from -KRW 2.9bn to -KRW 0.9bn, with a KRW 1.3bn profit as the Q3 consensus. Only Lightron stayed loss-making for four straight quarters (-KRW 2.3bn → -8.3bn → -1.7bn → -2.1bn), with revenue also declining. Actual Q3 figures for the three companies with consensus will be reported around mid-November.

03The Four Companies in the Optical Value Chain and the US Cycle Link

The four Korean stocks often move in the same direction as US optical stocks (Corning, Lumentum, Ciena, Coherent), but a direct trading relationship is confirmed only between RF Materials and Lumentum. For the rest, the link is sentiment and industry conditions tied to the same AI investment cycle.

Why Korean Stocks Fall Harder

  • Five-session declines are larger in Korea (-22% to -30%) than in the US (-14% to -21%).
  • The Oct 15 drop (-7% to -16%) includes the KOSDAQ index's own -7.65% on top of the sector shock.
  • Small-cap KOSDAQ stocks with a high retail share swing more on the same shock (60-day volatility of 119% to 146%).

Lag: How a US Plunge Shows Up in Korea

  • US optical plunge on Monday Oct 12 → Korea Oct 13: RF Materials -7.4%, OE Solutions -6.1%, Taihan -3.5%.
  • On Oct 14 as well: RF Materials -7.4%, Lightron -7.9%.
  • US plunge on Oct 14 → Korea Oct 15: Taihan -15.1%, RF Materials -16.3%, OE Solutions -13.5%, Lightron -7.1%.

Which Parts of the US Cycle Matter for Korea

US indicatorNext dateWhy it matters for Korean stocks
Lumentum FY27 Q1 results and guidance (guidance USD 1.225 to 1.275bn)Nov 5, after the closeLeading indicator for RF Materials' Q3 and Q4 orders. Whether guidance is met is the key
Big tech and semiconductor executives' funding commentsOngoingBroadcom and Intel remarks were the direct trigger of the optical sell-off. Most sensitive to signs of a change in capex pace
Corning fiber contracts and pricingNext earnings date not confirmedIndirect indicator of Taihan's fiber selling prices and US cable demand
Summary. After two sharp falls on Oct 12 and Oct 14, Corning is down 48% from its high and Ciena 44%. On top of that, the four Korean stocks carried the KOSDAQ plunge and their own flows, so they fell more. There is no guarantee that Korean stocks will recover by the same magnitude if the US cycle rebounds. RF Materials, which has earnings, is likely to be valued on Lumentum's numbers; the others on the speed of their own turn to profit.

Why target prices are hard to take at face value. RF Materials' average target of KRW 72,667 is about 100x its 2026E EPS of KRW 727 (72,667/727=99.9x), and OE Solutions' average target of KRW 47,500 was set while 2026E EPS is -KRW 24. Targets presuppose profit from 2027 onward, so they may be adjusted together if Q3 results fall short of expectations. Taihan and Lightron have no target-price consensus at all.

Conclusion
As of today, the setup does not look favorable by this analysis for any of the four stocks. The reason is the market shock and price, not sector substance. Of the four, only RF Materials has earnings support; for the rest, profit has yet to catch up with price. Checking in stages, namely market stabilization, Q3 results, and Lumentum's Nov 5 earnings, is a reasonable approach on this analysis.
  • The positives lie in RF Materials' confirmed numbers. Q2 operating profit of KRW 5.3bn, a 21.1% margin, and a 33.4% debt ratio are results, not forecasts.
  • The negatives are concentrated in price and timing. Taihan's 17.4x P/B, Lightron's losses, the KOSDAQ circuit breakers, and consecutive US optical plunges all landed in the same week. Declines on days like this often did not end in a single day.
  • The four differ in character. RF Materials is tied to Lumentum's numbers; for Taihan it is the speed of the turn to profit; for OE Solutions, narrowing losses and whether the 224-day MA break holds; for Lightron, earnings visibility.
  • Remaining uncertainty. Nobody can yet determine whether today's plunge was a temporary shock or an inflection point in the AI investment cycle.

Indicators are computed from the last 1,100 sessions of daily bars; weekly and monthly bars are built by aggregating daily bars. The percentage range is the zone's top to bottom relative to the current price.

How "Dante" technique was applied. "Dante" is the handle of a well-known Korean stock YouTuber (주식단테) whose chart method looks for traces of large-player accumulation. This report shows Dante's 112/224/448-day moving averages alongside the requested 122/244/444-day lines, and finds on the daily bars the signals Dante cites as evidence of accumulation, attaching a checklist to each stock. There are five criteria. ① Base candle (accumulation candle): a bullish candle with volume at least 2x the prior 20-day average and a body of at least 3%. ② Base-candle open as support: whether later closes hold that open (Dante treats this open as the large player's average cost and a breakdown level). ③ Volume drying up after heavy volume. ④ Time correction below the 224-day MA: whether a "bowl pattern" second leg (sideways trade of four months or more) exists. ⑤ Suspected-breakdown candle: a long bearish candle on volume of 2x or more within 15% of the 52-week high. The ▲ markers and dotted lines on the charts are base candles within the last 150 sessions and their opens (orange = still holding, gray = already broken). Small caps often have volume-surge days, so many base candles are detected and care is needed in interpretation. The criteria are quantified from secondary sources summarizing the method, not from Dante's original videos, and may differ from Dante's own judgment.

Accumulation evidence summary. No valid base candle remains above the current price (the May 7 open of KRW 44,900 was broken). With the 224-day MA (KRW 25,460) crossed downward for the first time today, from the standpoint of Dante's "dead-cross pullback" technique the first thing to check is whether a time correction continues below the 224-day MA. The Support 1 zone is where the 60-day MA, 50% retracement, and 244-day MA overlap.

What to Check When Price Reaches a Zone

ItemWhat a pullback can look likeWhat a breakdown looks like
VolumeArrives with volume below the 20-day average (Taihan about 14.03mn shares, RF Materials about 1.01mn, Lightron about 19.55mn, OE Solutions about 0.46mn)Breaks the bottom of the zone on volume well above the average
RSIDaily RSI falls below 30, then rebounds back above 30Weekly RSI falls below 40, weakening the trend
Candle shapeA long lower-wick candle or a long bullish candle within the zoneCloses below the zone for two or more days
Foreign investorsForeign net buying for two or more days (as of Oct 15, three stocks have net buying)Foreign net selling continues even as the index rebounds
MarketSupport at KOSDAQ 742 (61.8%), US optical sell-off calmsFurther index plunge. Individual support levels break easily during index plunges
Limitations of this section. This is general analysis of where chart supports overlap, not investment advice tailored to any individual's situation. Claims that a touch of a moving average leads to a rebound with high probability are not verified statistics. Price may rebound without reaching any of the three zones, or break down through all of them. In particular, small caps often have thin volume so technical supports frequently fail to work, and some zones for Taihan and Lightron sit in volume gaps, so passage through them can be fast.
